nodes.label: Official Furniture Set Definition
nodes.rationale: The official set is decided one-to-one by JSON/furniture/furniture_official_catagory.json plus the GLB and image result manifests: 8,557 identical item_id/id values, 8,557 GLB, 25,671 three-view images, publishable upload_status and HTTPS delivery_url.

nodes.label: Manifest SHA-256 Mirror Requirement
nodes.rationale: backend/catalog/data/manifests/ is a synchronized copy that must be byte-identical (per-file SHA-256) to JSON/manifests/, so the runtime copy can never silently drift from the delivered handoff.

nodes.label: 7,958 Active vs 599 Quarantined Split
nodes.rationale: 7,958 items are is_active=true and eligible for API/RAG; 599 are manually isolated with is_active=false while their manifests and cloud assets are retained. furniture_catalog_6styles_zh.json keeps only top-level styles and taxonomy with an empty furniture array as a style-display definition.
